notes:
v4.6.117 — Buy bots in the market + cleaner pricing

🛒 Fixed: installing/buying a paid bot from the market silently failed — the request wasn't signed in, so the server returned 'Sign in to purchase'. Purchases now go through with your account, and any error (e.g. not enough credits) shows a clear message. Downloading a bot YOU published is free (no charge for your own work).

◊ Bot prices now show in credits only (no dollar figure).

🔇 Also: Alpaca and IBKR keep independent bot lists, so silencing a bot on one broker no longer silences its twin on the other.

Update via the in-app banner.
